title: now_utc_string_checked: wrong time of day before epoch
description: crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs now_utc_string_checked computes minutes and hours as (secs / 60).rem_euclid(60) and (secs / 3600).rem_euclid(24). Rust '/' truncates toward zero, so for negative secs the time of day is wrong: secs = -1 formats as 1969-12-31T00:00:59.mmmZ, but GNU 'date -u -d @-1' gives 1969-12-31T23:59:59Z. The function's rustdoc claims the rem_euclid/div_euclid math handles arbitrarily large negative offsets. Fix: derive h/m/s from secs.rem_euclid(86400), as utc_date_from_epoch_seconds (bd:JMAP-nbk3.3) does. Found during JMAP-nbk3.3; out of scope there.
